title: Unbounded wide-string concatenation (c)
description: The code appends a wide string with wcscat, which has no destination size and counts nothing. Repeated appends in a loop grow past the allocation without any single call looking wrong.
remediation: Append with a bounded helper that takes the remaining element count, for example a bounded append with the remaining capacity.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the append without tracking buffer growth across iterations.
